code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base_color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    hr = [r for r, v in enumerate(row_modes) if v != base_color]
    vc = [c for c, v in enumerate(col_modes) if v != base_color]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(hr, hr[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(vc, vc[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != base_color and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else base_color)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
